Package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors
Allocation-free Grove sensor drivers for digital, analog, I2C and infrared modules connected through the GroveBaseShield pin map. The supported temperature modules are Seeed's Grove Temperature and Humidity Sensor Pro and Grove Temperature & Humidity Sensor (DHT11).
